decisions.reason: As a newly launched operator line with its own page and strong fit to the firm’s core garage-door system business, it is likely to remain while management uses its slack to learn about demand rather than exit early.

The solid wood sectional garage door is more niche and only lightly signaled on the website, so its aspiration test is less certain, but the product still fits the firm’s customization strategy well enough to keep for now.
A remote-control garage door operator is close to the established offer and likely benefits from cross-selling, so even if early results are modest management would usually keep it another year.

The glazed industrial sectional door extends the industrial door range in a familiar direction, and a large German manufacturer would typically tolerate some early uncertainty before reallocating resources.
The glazed insulated industrial sectional door matches customer needs for compliance and thermal performance, so it likely stays unless its first-year results fall clearly below aspiration.

Because this glazed industrial sectional door had a page of its own, suggesting stronger internal commitment or market traction, management is likely to keep it on the market while performance becomes clearer.
